title: Northern Ontario Land & Tax Sale Tracker
criteria: Unorganized land from Sudbury north (Timmins area ideal; farther north fine; nothing south of Sudbury). Goal ~150 acres with road frontage, ideally from a tax sale. Research only for now.

parcels.name: Martin Bird Rd (PCL 15528 & 15527)
parcels.area: Hearst Twp / Larder Lake (near Kirkland Lake)
parcels.frontage: ~1,436 ft on public road (Martin Bird Rd off Hwy 624)
parcels.notes: MLS T13654964, listed Aug 8 2026, still for sale at $120,000 as of Oct 25 (no price change). Assessed $30,600 (2026). ORGANIZED township of Larder Lake, so it doesn't meet the unorganized criterion. NR zoning: a new house likely not allowed - confirm with township. Nov 1: still For Sale at $120,000. Also listed on Infrastructure Ontario's surplus property portal (IO #641, 102 ac, $120,000, posted Aug 11 2026), so the seller is the Province.

parcels.name: McGarry 180.38 acres (Roll 54 58 000 004 36800)
parcels.area: McGarry Twp near Virginiatown (Timiskaming) - organized township
parcels.zoning: MX - Extractive Industrial (gravel pit on site)
parcels.notes: Tax sale closed Oct 1, 2026 with no valid tenders. Five former mining-claim parcels, minimum bid far above assessed value, industrial gravel-pit zoning. Poor homestead fit; the township may relist or vest it later. Oct 25: OntarioTaxSales still shows 'No valid tenders or bids received'; no relist or vesting notice found. Nov 1: result still 'No valid tenders or bids received'; no relist or vesting notice found.
parcels.status: Tax sale failed (no bids) - not a fit

parcels.name: South Porcupine near Hwy 101 - 243.43 acres (Infrastructure Ontario #600)
parcels.area: South Porcupine, City of Timmins (organized), near Hwy 101
parcels.price: Not applicable (no public price; IO lists 'Not Applicable')
parcels.sale_type: Provincial surplus land (Infrastructure Ontario) - direct sale negotiation
parcels.frontage: Unconfirmed (IO lists location as 'Near Hwy 101'; detail page would not load)
parcels.notes: VERIFIED Nov 1 2026: Infrastructure Ontario's Properties for Sale portal lists ID 600 'South Porcupine Near Hwy 101, Timmins', Northern Ontario, 243.43 acres, price Not Applicable, status 'In Negotiations for Direct Sale', posted Mar 3 2022. IO defines that status as an expression of interest from a government or broader public sector entity; it may go to the open market only if that direct sale falls through. Not available to the public now. Organized (City of Timmins). Watch for a status change to 'Listed on the Open Market'. IO detail page returned a server error, so frontage/zoning unconfirmed.

parcels.name: PCL 1175 Coulson Township - 160 acres
parcels.area: Coulson Twp, NE of Matheson (Cochrane District) - UNORGANIZED
parcels.frontage: No road frontage; logging-road access (near Hwy 101 & Hwy 11)
parcels.notes: MLS T13427242 (HomeLife Optimum). Surface and tree rights (except pine). Seller will consider a vendor take-back mortgage with 50% down. Taxes about $50/yr. GPS 48.67222, -80.31442. Closest size match to the 150-acre goal, but access is by logging road only. Still listed at $120,000 as of Oct 25 (listing last updated Aug 7). Nov 1: still $120,000 (listing last updated Aug 7).

parcels.name: Lot 12 PCL 1859 Pyne Twp - 134.5 acres
parcels.area: Pyne Twp, near Cochrane (Cochrane District) - UNORGANIZED
parcels.frontage: 3-season road access (Heikkila Rd at Fox Con 1) plus 800+ ft of Abitibi River frontage
parcels.notes: MLS T13693534 (Royal LePage Northern Realty Leaders), listed Aug 19 2026. Densely treed mature timber, small area cleared ~20 years ago. Taxes about $180/yr. Road is 3-season, not year-round. Still For Sale at $129,900 as of Oct 25 (only price history entry Aug 19). Nov 1: still For Sale at $129,900.

parcels.name: PT LT 11 Con 6 Fournier Twp - Hwy 11, 65.58 acres
parcels.area: Fournier Twp, ~10.5 km west of Cochrane - UNORGANIZED
parcels.price: $119,400 (MLS list price; cut from $139,900 on Oct 22, 2026)
parcels.notes: MLS T13200124, listed May 27 2026; price reduced $20,500 to $119,400 on Oct 22 2026 (buyrealty listing history). Taxes $300/yr (2026). Surface, mineral and timber rights; seasonal creek; Crown land on east and west sides; older trailer included as-is. Smaller than the goal but has the year-round highway frontage the plan calls for. About 1 h 25 min to Timmins. Nov 1: still $119,400, no further change.

parcels.name: PCL 399 Holmes Twp - 169 acres
parcels.area: Holmes Twp, just east of Matachewan (Timiskaming District) - UNORGANIZED
parcels.frontage: Unconfirmed (cross streets Hwy 66 & Watabeag Rd; listing does not describe road access)
parcels.notes: MLS T13857208 (Royal LePage Northern Life Realty), listed Oct 2 2026. Crown land on 3 sides, logging rights included. Lot approx 2,639 x 2,754 ft. Taxes $250/yr (2026). Biggest and cheapest unorganized parcel found so far; access needs confirming. Roughly 1.5 h from Timmins (estimate, unverified). Nov 1: still For Sale at $89,000; access still not described.

parcels.name: Lot 26 Con 7 near Hearst - 150 acres
parcels.area: Unorganized township ~10 min from Hearst (Cochrane District), near Hwy 583 S & Huard Rd - UNORGANIZED
parcels.frontage: Seasonal road access; lot front listed as 1,660 ft (depth 3,920 ft)
parcels.notes: MLS T13053332 (RE/MAX Crown Realty (1989)), listed Apr 28 2026. Exactly the 150-acre goal. In WMU 23, surrounded by Crown land, old trail to a natural clearing, seasonal creek. Taxes $594.53 (2025). Township name not stated in listing. Hearst is far north (~3 h from Timmins, estimate). Nov 1: still For Sale at $100,000.

parcels.name: PCL 11104 Pt Lt 12 Con 6 Murphy Twp - 160 acres
parcels.area: Murphy Twp, ~18 km NW of downtown Timmins (City of Timmins) - organized
parcels.frontage: Unconfirmed (cross street Hwy 655; 'fronting on East' per listing, no road described)
parcels.notes: MLS T14109418 (HomeLife Optimum), listing updated Oct 22 2026. Surface, mineral and tree rights (except pine). Borders Crown land to the west; Kidd Creek along west edge; 5 lakes within 2.5 km. Taxes $297.09 (2026). ORGANIZED (inside Timmins), so it misses the unorganized criterion, but it's in the ideal Timmins area and Rural zoning may allow a house. Nov 1: still $89,000; listing description edited Oct 28 (no price change).

parcels.name: Lot 3 Con 5 Little Twp - 159 acres
parcels.area: Little Twp, Cochrane District (Cochrane Unorganized; listing city Iroquois Falls) - UNORGANIZED
parcels.frontage: No road frontage; access via logging roads across Crown land (west on Berlinghoff Rd ~13.5 km from Hwy 11 to SW corner)
parcels.notes: MLS T13250402 (Town & Country Realty (TBAY)), on REALTOR.ca ~185 days (listed about Apr 30 2026; no price change found). Surrounded by Crown land; surface, mineral and tree rights; appears to have old-growth timber. Lot 2,656 x 2,622 ft. Taxes $525 (2025). Little Twp is roughly 35 km NE of Timmins per an Ontario Geological Survey report. Cheapest ~150-acre unorganized parcel found so far; no road frontage.

parcels.name: Lot 11 Con 2 - 160 acres (Unorganized West Timiskaming)
parcels.area: Unorganized West Timiskaming (TIM - Outside - Rural, P0J 1M0), near Heather Lake & Honeymoon Lake - UNORGANIZED
parcels.price: $175,000 (MLS list price; earlier listings at $275,000 expired)
parcels.frontage: No road frontage; ATV/logging roads across Crown land
parcels.notes: MLS T12964312 (Century 21 Temiskaming Plus), listed Apr 2026, extended to Mar 2027; previously listed at $275,000 (T9280939 2024, T11997533 2025, both expired). Never cut, mature timber, timber rights included. Lot 2,600 x 2,600 ft. Taxes $69.58 (2025). Township name not stated.

parcels.name: 1/2 Lt 9 Con 1 McCann - 160 acres (Watabeag area)
parcels.area: Near Matheson, Cochrane District (listing says 'unorganized township of Watabeag'; legal says McCann) - UNORGANIZED
parcels.frontage: Unconfirmed ('on Watabeag Road near Matheson'; call agent for directions)
parcels.notes: MLS T9398020 (Zieminski Real Estate), listed Oct 16 2024. Open land, southern edge borders Crown land, access to a private lake, timber and mineral rights except pine. Only seen as 'Active' on realty.ca (an aggregator); not confirmed on REALTOR.ca, so the listing may be stale. Township name inconsistent in listing.

sources.name: Infrastructure Ontario - Properties for Sale portal

log.entry: Tracker created. Re-verified Larder Lake MLS T13654964: $120K, just over 101 acres, NR zoning, organized township. McGarry and South Porcupine carried over from earlier research, not re-verified.

Weekly check. Timmins first: the city's spring tax sale was cancelled (all 3 properties redeemed) and no new Timmins tax sale is posted; council vested several failed tax-sale vacant parcels (incl. Ogden, Godfrey and Whitney Twp land) to sell later by tender or direct sale, worth watching. McGarry 180 ac: Oct 1 tax sale failed with no bids ($173,711 minimum, gravel-pit MX zoning, private road) - not a fit. Larder Lake 101 ac still listed at $120K, unchanged. South Porcupine 243 ac still unconfirmed. New unorganized-township listings added: Coulson Twp 160 ac $120K (logging-road access, seller financing possible), Pyne Twp 134.5 ac $129,900 (3-season road, Abitibi River frontage), Fournier Twp 65.58 ac $139,900 (Hwy 11 frontage). No northern Infrastructure Ontario land sales or new Gazette tax sales from Sudbury north with large acreage found; Moosonee tax sale postponed.

Weekly check. Changes: Fournier Twp 65.58 ac price cut from $139,900 to $119,400 (Oct 22). Added 3 new parcels: Holmes Twp 169 ac $89,000 (unorganized, east of Matachewan, MLS T13857208, access unconfirmed); Lot 26 Con 7 near Hearst 150 ac $100,000 (unorganized, seasonal road, MLS T13053332); Murphy Twp 160 ac $89,000 (organized, City of Timmins, MLS T14109418). Unchanged: Larder Lake $120K, Coulson $120K, Pyne $129,900 all still listed. McGarry: no relist found. South Porcupine 243 ac still unverified. Noted but not added: Hanlan Twp near Hearst 73.1 ac $80,000 (under 80 ac). Tax sales: no large-acreage tax sales from Sudbury north found; Greater Sudbury Nov 3 tender includes Keast Dr (~51 ac, urban Sudbury, min $67,158.12) - not a fit. Timmins: no new tax sale or city land sale posted; vested Ogden/Godfrey/Whitney parcels not yet offered. Infrastructure Ontario surplus list shows no large northern acreage.

Weekly check. South Porcupine 243 ac VERIFIED: Infrastructure Ontario surplus parcel #600 (243.43 ac near Hwy 101, Timmins), status 'In Negotiations for Direct Sale' since 2022, so not available to the public. Added 3 new unorganized parcels: Little Twp 159 ac $79,000 (MLS T13250402, ~35 km NE of Timmins, logging-road access); Lot 11 Con 2 Unorganized West Timiskaming 160 ac $175,000 (MLS T12964312, ATV/logging access); McCann/Watabeag 160 ac $127,000 (MLS T9398020, listing status unconfirmed). All 8 other parcels unchanged in price and still listed; Larder Lake is an IO surplus listing (IO #641). McGarry still not relisted. Tax sales: no large-acreage tax sales from Sudbury north; Greater Sudbury cancelled the Keast Dr (~51 ac) tender for Nov 3. Timmins: no tax sale or city land sale posted; per the Mar 2026 vesting report the Ogden Twp parcel is for direct sale to abutting owners and Godfrey/Whitney Twp parcels are retained by the city, so none will be offered publicly. Noted only: Prince Twp (Algoma, near Sault Ste. Marie) 320 ac $499,900 with wind leases - over budget and at/below Sudbury's latitude.
